definitions.gloss: flowering tree; ornamental tree; flowering shrub
definitions.explanation: Trees and shrubs that are cultivated or valued primarily for their flowers. Includes cherry blossoms, plum blossoms, azaleas, camellias, and similar decorative plants.

examples.english: To plant flowering trees in the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な{花木|かぼく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{植|う}えられている→植える：01210_ueru⟧。
examples.english: Various flowering trees are planted in this park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{花木|かぼく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{咲|さ}き→咲く：08150_saku⟧{始|はじ}め、{園内|えんない}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{華|はな}やか→華やか：06070_hanayaka⟧な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: In spring, the flowering trees begin to bloom all at once, and the grounds are enveloped in a gorgeous atmosphere.

notes:
A compound of {花|か} (flower) and {木|ぼく} (tree). A general term encompassing all trees and shrubs grown for their ornamental blossoms. Common in gardening, landscaping, and botanical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花木|かぼく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{植|う}える→植える：01210_ueru⟧: to plant flowering trees
- {花木|かぼく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧: care of flowering trees
- {花木|かぼく}{園|えん}: flowering tree garden
- {花木|かぼく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{剪定|せんてい}→剪定：06327_sentei⟧: pruning of flowering trees

EXAMPLES OF {花木|かぼく}:
- ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧: cherry blossom
- ⟦{梅|うめ}→梅：01869_ume⟧: plum blossom
- ⟦{椿|つばき}→椿：04401_tsubaki⟧: camellia

- ⟦{樹木|じゅもく}→樹木：04955_jumoku⟧: tree — general term for trees, regardless of flowers
- ⟦{草花|くさばな}→草花：23050_kusabana⟧: flowering plants — specifically herbaceous (non-woody) flowering plants, as opposed to trees
